atoms.text: Although it remains unclear whether it was Alexander Graham Bell or Elisha Gray who invented the telephone, the first time that a telephone was successfully used was in 1876.

It looked very different compared to modern telephones, and only a few people were able to own one. It was a big apparatus with two pieces, one to speak with and one to hear with, connected by a wire.

hint.text: An apparatus is a piece of equipment.
hint.label: Apparatus

atoms.text: Over time, due to technological progress, the telephone became cheaper, and also started to look different.
In 1973, almost one hundred years later, the first mobile phone was used. It was a lot bigger and heavier than current mobiles.

However, over time, mobile phones became smaller and could also do more things than just call another person. For example, it became possible to take pictures or search the internet. The latest and most drastic changes happened in 2007. Since then, most mobile phones have had touchscreens.
